blogs.title: How to Relocate to the Netherlands via Study Route in 2026
blogs.content:
Studying in the Netherlands is one of the most reliable pathways to relocating to Europe. The country offers highly ranked universities, english-taught programs, and an orientation year (zoekjaar) post-graduation to find a high-skilled job.

First, choose your course and verify the university entry requirements. Most institutions require academic transcripts and English language proficiency certification. Next, prepare your proof of financial support. You must demonstrate that you have enough funds to cover tuition and living expenses. Once admitted, the university typically handles your student visa application (MVV) with the IND.

blogs.title: Top 5 Schengen Visa Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
blogs.content:
Securing a Schengen visa can feel overwhelming. Many applications are rejected due to simple errors. Here is how to keep your application clean:

  1. Incomplete Travel Itinerary: Avoid booking flights before your visa is approved. Use flight reservations.
  2. Insufficient Financial Proof: Ensure your bank statements are active and cover the required minimum daily spend.
  3. Unmatching Accommodation Info: Your hotel booking dates must align precisely with your flight reservations.
